description: A page of this site's own in the Konsol Handbook, beside the product guide that ships with Konsol (konsol#407, Handbook option C). EPM Admin writes it; every Handbook reader sees it once published.

fields.label: Title
fields.description: What the reader looks for, for example "Our close calendar".

fields.label: Section
fields.description: The heading the Handbook lists this page under. Pages with the same section are listed together; the product guide's sections are Start here and Concepts.

fields.label: Audience
fields.options:
Everyone
Entity Accountant
Group Accountant
Close Lead
Viewer
fields.description: Who the page is for. The Handbook's audience filter shows a role's pages and Everyone's. It is a reading aid, not a permission: every Handbook reader can open every published page.

fields.label: Sort Order
fields.description: Lower first among this site's pages; pages with the same number are listed by title. This site's pages are listed after the product's.

fields.label: Published
fields.description: Shown in the Konsol Handbook. Until it is ticked, only an EPM Admin or System Manager can open the page.

fields.label: Body
fields.description: Markdown. Scripts, styles, forms, frames and event attributes are removed before it is shown. Links may be http, https, mailto or a Desk route such as /desk/period-close.

name: Konsol Guide Page
